title: The next place i leave - CHRIS YAKOPCIC

lines.l: The bottom shelf, cause I thought you'd like to remember just the way we smell
But I can't sit still, I need a thrill and for the street to meet the bottoms of my feet
She was just one more stop
Before the next place I leave
Spittin' gravel into my wheel well
Racin' a cloud of dust
The kind of sheriff caught me
Runnin' from my cell
Between the flap rim on his head
And the crooked badge on his shirt
They served me up one freshly made county sheriff's smirk
And I gave him the most sincere thank you I knew no one would believe
He was just one more stop
Before the next place I leave
Well, I had dinner with the devil
Negotiating terms
He tried to use that dark black ink
To leave me no room to squirm
And I'd have a golden fiddle
And I'd solo all night long
If it weren't for his insistence of a non-compete clause
So I tore his deal up with my teeth
I'm a ragged rebel with everything I need
He was just one more stop
Before the next place I leave
Jazz Radio Blues
Le meilleur du blues
A kiss goodnight over the phone
